build_model_parallel_transformer_lm: build a ModelParallelTransformerLanguageModel from args and task using the build_model class method
build_vocab_parallel_embedding: build a VocabParallelEmbedding for the target dictionary with the specified embedding dimension
configure_transformer_lm_megatron_archit: configure the transformer_lm_megatron architecture with 3072 embed dim and 72 decoder layers
configure_transformer_lm_gpt_architectur: configure the transformer_lm_gpt architecture with 768 embed dim and 12 decoder layers
configure_transformer_lm_gpt2_tiny_archi: configure the transformer_lm_gpt2_tiny architecture with 64 embed dim and 2 decoder layers
